challenge.method: Tested an authorized 1.1-or-later notice listing only a Back-Cover Text, then removed the designation, withheld the notice, and separately restricted the grant to 1.1. Tested a later published edition and an unpublished draft against GNU section 10.
challenge.results: The cover-only notice qualifies even with zero Invariant Sections. Removing its sole designation defeats the feature condition. Withholding the notice leaves the condition unknown. Restricting the grant to 1.1 defeats the later-version condition alone. Section 10 admits later FSF-published, non-draft editions while retaining 1.1 as the specified starting edition. A notice starting at 1.2 or 1.3 describes a different choice.

limitations: The prose spelling GFDL-1.1-or-later-invariants reverses the suffixes. The comment does the same for the no-invariants alternative.
The generic or-later entry has the same example header. The header alone cannot establish that any feature was designated in an actual notice.
